--- create_model_nested_complex.sql
CREATE MODEL m
INPUT (
  feature ARRAY<STRUCT<l2 STRUCT<l3 STRUCT<l4 STRUCT<l5 INT64>>>>>
)
OUTPUT (
  label STRUCT<foo ARRAY<STRUCT<bar STRING(MAX), str STRUCT<field1 ARRAY<FLOAT64>, field2 BOOL>>>>
)
REMOTE

--- AST
&ast.CreateModel{
  Remote: 202,
  Name:   &ast.Ident{
    NamePos: 13,
    NameEnd: 14,
    Name:    "m",
  },
  InputOutput: &ast.CreateModelInputOutput{
    Input:        15,
    Rparen:       200,
    InputColumns: []*ast.CreateModelColumn{
      &ast.CreateModelColumn{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 25,
          NameEnd: 32,
          Name:    "feature",

          Gt:     88,
          Rparen: -1,
          Item:   &ast.StructType{

              &ast.StructField{

                      Ident: &ast.Ident{
                        NamePos: 133,

--- SQL
CREATE MODEL m INPUT (feature ARRAY<STRUCT<l2 STRUCT<l3 STRUCT<l4 STRUCT<l5 INT64>>>>>) OUTPUT (label STRUCT<foo ARRAY<STRUCT<bar STRING(MAX), str STRUCT<field1 ARRAY<FLOAT64>, field2 BOOL>>>>) REMOTE
